title: Glokzin Teal Cabinet Pull, 3-Inch Solid Brass Cabinet-Mount Traditional Handle, 3.9 In Length, Allied Brass
description: Cabinet pull (cabinet handle) for cabinets and drawers, sized at 3 inches (3-inch, 3 in) with solid brass construction and cabinet-mount installation in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Use as a cabinet pull or drawer pull to update kitchen or bathroom cabinetry in a traditional style. Overall dimensions: 3.9 inches length (3.9 in), 1.6 inches height (1.6 in), 0.9 inches width (0.9 in); 1 inch projection (1 in). Weight capacity: 2 lb. Includes the cabinet pull and all installation hardware; assembly required: false. Offered in multiple designer finish options for corrosion-free and rust-free performance. Limited lifetime warranty. Complements traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures. Allied Brass.
